meta_description: How HLlama works, what happens to your information and what your rights are, before you give or refuse your consent.
page_intro: Here is how HLlama works, what is done with your information, and what you get to decide. Take your time: your choice is free, either way.
policy_document_title: Service and privacy policy — HLlama, Umbaji's health assistant
policy_meta_description: HLlama terms of use and privacy policy: service scope, data processed, retention period and your rights.
policy_page_intro: What HLlama covers, the information it processes, how long it is kept and your rights. It is the same text as the one shown before consent.
policy_link_label: Read the policy on its own page
key_points: The Umbaji team does not read your conversations.
Your messages are not used to train any artificial intelligence.
You can refuse, or stop using HLlama, whenever you want.
decision_intro: Before you choose, please make sure you have read and understood the information above.
decision_points: By choosing "I agree", you confirm that you have read these terms and understood how HLlama works in general, which information may be processed and why it is used.

You understand that some of the information you share may concern your health or other sensitive parts of your private life, and you accept that it is processed as far as necessary for you to use HLlama.
You also understand that the Umbaji team does not read your conversations, and that their content is not used to train HLlama or other artificial intelligence models.
checkbox_label: I have read and understood the information above.
accept_hint: Tick the box above to enable this choice.
free_choice: Your choice is free. Refusing has no consequence, other than HLlama not being able to answer you.
success_accepted_body: You can now talk with HLlama on WhatsApp.
success_refused_body: No data will be processed. You can come back whenever you want.
redirect_blocked: If nothing happens, tap the button above.
error_title: Your choice could not be saved
error_invalid_token: This link is no longer valid. Ask HLlama for a new one on WhatsApp by writing "consent".
error_network: The connection failed. Check your internet connection, then try again.
error_offline: You appear to be offline. Reconnect, then try again.
error_generic: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment.
no_token_body: You can read the whole text below, but saving your choice needs a personal link. Write "consent" to HLlama on WhatsApp to get a new one.
noscript_message: The text below is fully readable without JavaScript, but saving your choice needs it. Enable JavaScript, then reload this page.
footer_rights: You can ask to access, correct or delete your data at any time.
link_used_title: This link has already been used
link_used_body: Your choice was recorded, and a consent link works only once. To change your decision, write "consent" to HLlama on WhatsApp and you will get a new link.
link_expired_body: A consent link stays valid for 24 hours. Write "consent" to HLlama on WhatsApp to get a new one.
link_invalid_body: It may have been cut short on the way. Write "consent" to HLlama on WhatsApp to get a new one.
error_already_used: This link has already recorded a choice. Ask HLlama for a new one on WhatsApp by writing "consent".
read_only_notice: You can still read the whole text below.
